carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single, sharply defined horizontal ridge is visible along the midline of the tail peduncle, marking a high-contrast transition between the darker dorsal pixels and the lighter ventral pixels of the lower caudal lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark, irregularly shaped mark is visible on the lower lobe of the caudal fin, featuring a roughly circular base with a thin, hook-like projection extending towards the fin's interior.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of high-luminance circular spots are arranged in semi-vertical rows along the tail peduncle, with a specific grouping of four spots forming a trapezoidal pattern on the upper margin of the peduncle-caudal transition.
